description: Create an EMPTY order for a rental period (status new or draft). Then add products with booqable_book_product and reserve it with booqable_transition_order_status. Locations default to the first active location. Booqable: POST /api/4/orders.

customer_id.description: The customer this order is for.

starts_at.description: Rental start, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

status.description: Initial status. Default new (visible only to its creator); draft is visible but reserves nothing.

stops_at.description: Rental end, ISO 8601 at the company's local time written as UTC, e.g. 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z means 10:00 at the shop. Do not convert to real UTC.

name: booqable_create_order
title: Create an order
